```{r}

samples <- list.files("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/0_james/projects/Xenium/Xenium_files")
clean_samples <- samples[!grepl("\\.zarr$", samples)]

sm_folders <- (paste0("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/0_james/projects/Xenium/Xenium_files/", clean_samples, "/cell_feature_matrix"))

sceList <- function(x, y){
    counts_matrix <- Read10X(data.dir = x)[['Gene Expression']]
    
    # 3. Manually fix the row names that Read10X is failing to clean
    #    This replaces all underscores with dashes
    rownames(counts_matrix) <- gsub("_", "-", rownames(counts_matrix))

      tmp_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
      counts = (counts_matrix),
      min.cells = 3, 
      project = y)
    
    #tmp_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(object = tmp_obj, pattern = "^mt-")
    #tmp_obj <- subset(tmp_obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & percent.mt < 20)
    #tmp_obj <- subset(tmp_obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 )
    require(future)
    plan("multisession", workers = 4)
    options(future.globals.maxSize = 10000 * 1024^2)
    tmp_obj <- NormalizeData(tmp_obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
    tmp_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(tmp_obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 4000)
    tmp_obj <- ScaleData(tmp_obj, features = rownames(tmp_obj))
    tmp_obj <- RunPCA(tmp_obj, features = VariableFeatures(tmp_obj), npcs = 50)
    return(tmp_obj)
}

Y1738 <- sceList(sm_folders[1], samples[1])
saveRDS(Y1738, file = "//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/data/1_DoubleFinder_Y1738.rds")
```
